answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 45 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in voyage, queued in knoll, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 334 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4959 identities would post 4324 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
